# Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant, or add anything you think would be helpful.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Data pipeline / signature update (whitelist, YARA, ClamAV, xor filters)
- [ ] Localization / translation update
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist before requesting a review

- [ ] My code follows the existing code style of this project
- [ ] I have tested my changes on a physical device or emulator (Android 10+)
- [ ] The Rust native engine (`hydradragonandroid/`) builds successfully if modified
- [ ] The Gradle project builds successfully (`./gradlew assembleDebug`)
- [ ] I have tested data pipeline scripts locally (if applicable)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code

**Please ONLY submit your pull request to the "development-version" branch!**
